name: MoGe
subtitle: Unlocking Accurate Monocular Geometry Estimation for Open-Domain Images
thesis: 先学习 affine-invariant 点图，再用投影一致性恢复相机与形状。

name: Pow3R
subtitle: Empowering Unconstrained 3D Reconstruction with Camera and Scene Priors
thesis: 将可用的相机与深度信息作为条件，让同一模型应对不同几何约束。

name: CUT3R
subtitle: Continuous 3D Perception Model with Persistent State
thesis: 将历史场景压入持久状态，用持续更新代替整段重算。

name: StreamVGGT
subtitle: Streaming 4D Visual Geometry Transformer
thesis: 让离线多视骨干因果化，以 KV 缓存保存历史视图证据。

name: VGG-T³
subtitle: VGG-T³: Offline Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction at Scale
thesis: 把跨视图信息写入小网络参数，再用该网络回答几何查询。

name: ZipMap
subtitle: ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction via Test-Time Training
thesis: 将场景证据压缩到可更新的权重空间，分开编码成本与查询成本。

name: MASt3R
subtitle: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R
thesis: 保留点图几何，同时学习适合精确匹配的局部描述子。

name: MonST3R
subtitle: A Simple Approach for Estimating Geometry in the Presence of Motion
thesis: 使逐时刻点图适应动态场景，并用静态证据约束相机轨迹。

name: D4RT
subtitle: Efficiently Reconstructing Dynamic Scenes One D4RT at a Time
thesis: 把点的身份、目标时刻与输出参考系分离成一个统一 4D 查询。

name: pixelSplat
subtitle: 3D Gaussian Splats from Image Pairs for Scalable Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
thesis: 通过概率深度与可微采样，从两视图直接预测可渲染 Gaussian。

name: MVSplat
subtitle: Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Multi-View Images
thesis: 让 cost volume 显式承担深度搜索，再预测 Gaussian 外观与形状。

name: CroCo v2
subtitle: CroCo v2: Improved Cross-view Completion Pre-training for Stereo Matching and Optical Flow
thesis: 把跨视图补全扩展到真实配对、旋转位置编码和更强模型。

name: NAS3R
subtitle: From None to All: Self-Supervised 3D Reconstruction via Novel View Synthesis
thesis: 以新视图合成的闭环训练几何，检验无几何标注监督的可行边界。

name: Geometric Understanding
subtitle: On Geometric Understanding and Learned Priors in Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction Models
thesis: 用受控输入干预区分几何对应、单图先验与融合机制的作用。

name: GeoCond
subtitle: GeoCond: A Conditioning-Aware Reliability Adapter for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
thesis: 把预测的几何布局转成可诊断位姿病态性的分数。

name: LRM
subtitle: Large Reconstruction Model for Single Image to 3D
thesis: 以大规模多视监督学习单图到 triplane 辐射场的物体先验。

name: InstantMesh
subtitle: Efficient 3D Mesh Generation from a Single Image with Sparse-view Large Reconstruction Models
thesis: 将生成的多视图交给稀疏视图重建器，并直接优化可提取的网格表面。
